description: This file contains unit test fixtures and mock interactions for the WebAudioPlayerModuleService component in a media IPC system. It sets up mock objects, expectations, and helper methods to test the creation, destruction, and control of WebAudioPlayer instances, including handling of buffer operations, volume, device info, and state events.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerModuleServiceTests
